name: ptyper3-prof
description: CPU profiles for attributing the one-worker overhead of the parallel typer: the spike at `3c72e64ddf` without the flag and on one worker, the same on one worker without forcing the lazy vals of `definitions` first (`-Dscalac.parallelTyper.noForceLazyVals`), and the fix branch's tip on one worker. One fork each, re2s stopped after the typer. Read the per-op profiles over all threads: profdiff's graphs show the benchmark thread only, and a worker types on a thread of its own.

variantDescriptions.spike: the parallel typer spike at `3c72e64ddf`, without `-Yparallel-typer`
